newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends derivatives-led bourse off highs.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends derivatives-led bourse off highs.

text.p: 1141 GMT - German shares end bourse at higher levels on Thursday, but off earlier highs, in a session described by traders as being mainly led by derivatives before Friday's "triple-witching" expiry of DAX futures, DAX options and stock options. Dollar stable around 1.73 marks.
* DAX-30 index at 3,749.27, up 19 points or 0.51 pct.
* June DAX future at 3,755.5 points, up 29.
* VW advances strongly on options interest.
* Banks fall--Deutsche,Dresdner, Commerzbank lower on derivatives-led selling pressure.
